propositions: Reconcile passes must validate every mapped project and legacy_default is visible to the bridge bot via the target Jira backend before any outbound mutations occur.
Invisible or decommissioned mapped project keys currently pass syntactic validation and only fail deep in fan-out as ACLI errors; a preflight check must catch these before reconcile_once is called.
The legacy_default fallback is returned unvalidated from resolve_project, allowing invisible projects to drive unguarded CREATE storms; preflight must validate it when non-empty.
When projects mapping is empty, the configured query_project fallback must be included in the preflight visibility check.
Hard auth/transport errors (401/403/timeout/connection) must fail closed with a distinct message, not silently treat a partial project set as authoritative.

The preflight probe reuses AcliClient._direct_rest_get against the Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search endpoint with paginated PageBean results, and gates on configured backend == 'jira', skipping non-Cloud backends observably.
